The simulation results show that the cascading invulnerability of scale-free networks is positively related to power-law exponent γ and mean degree <;k>, as γ and <;k> are high correlative with the homogeneousness and sparseness of a network, so the more homogenous and sparse a network is, the more invulnerable it is to resist cascading failures.

articleTitle: FPGA implementation and verification of LDPC encoder with weight (3, 6) approximate lower triangular matrix
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2012 2nd International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Compared with general linear block code encoding, LDPC encoding with lower triangular check matrix and approximate lower triangular check matrix carry out encoding directly by parity check matrix H. This study used the weight (3, 6) approximate lower triangular regular parity check matrix to implement the LDPC encoding on the 5641R FPGA of the Software Define Radio system developed by National Instruments (NI) [1]. This study provided a detailed introduction to the encoding mechanism of the approximate lower triangular LDPC, and completed the implementation and hardware verification of FPGA SDR system.

articleTitle: Research on the panoramic image acquisition technology by ordinary camera
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2012 2nd International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: In This paper we investigated a panoramic image acquisition technology, By analyzing the conventional method, we proposed a new method. In the method, the image information obtained by camera was converted to the panoramic image by using Projection transformation and image mosaic technology. The demonstration of the image mosaic proved the flexibility of the method.

articleTitle: Diagnosing E-commerce website quality based on DEA
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2012 2nd International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: The website quality affects the success of E-commerce directly, and therefore reasonable quality evaluation and diagnosis of E-commerce website is of great practical significance. In this paper, DEA was adopted to evaluate the quality of E-commerce website and a quality diagnosis method was proposed based on DEA. Moreover, the system of quality evaluation target was setup. Finally, this method was proved to be effective and scientific by example analysis.

articleTitle: Training and application of process neural network based on quantum-behaved evolutionary algorithm
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2012 2nd International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Aiming at the problem that it is difficult for BP algorithm to converge because of more parameters in training of process neural networks based on orthogonal basis expansion, a quantum-behaved evolutionary algorithm is presented which combines the quantum theory and is to train the process neural network. The algorithm using the Pauli matrices to establish the axis of rotation, using qubits in Bloch sphere to rotate around the axis method to carry out optimal search, using the Hadamard gate achieve individual variability to avoid premature, and effectively overcomes the complex compute and easily plunges into local minimums about BP algorithm. Taking network traffic prediction as an application, the simulation results show that the algorithm is validity.

articleTitle: An on-line reconfigurable four-ary tree-based network on chip for distributed particle filters
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2012 2nd International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This paper presents an on-line reconfigurable four-ary tree-based network on chip for distributed particle filters. The proposed architecture model provides the capability of fast prototyping a large scale of particle filters system basing on the idea of reusability. Furthermore, it supports dynamic reconfiguration by regrouping PEs so as to reduce the overall traffic loads on communication infrastructure. After formulating the regrouping into number partitioning problem, we apply two heuristic algorithms which are Balanced Largest Differencing Method (BLDM) and Balanced Farthest Binding Method (BFBM) as reconfigure strategies. Finally, system level evaluation indicates that a huge decrease of traffic loads can be achieved with help of reconfigure feature.

articleTitle: Technology of QoS evaluation based grey system theory
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2012 2nd International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Grey system theory is a new method that studies less data, poor information uncertainty problems. Grey system theory, with "small sample" of which "partial information is known, some of the information is unknown" and "poor information" uncertainty system as the research object, mainly through the generation and development of "partial" known information, extracts valuable information and realizes the correct description and effective monitoring of the system operation behavior and the evolution law. At present in the research of the Web Service Composition indicator information of each service is obtained by the mining for the execution log and statistical analysis. But, due to the high degree of autonomy of Web services, the historical data of QoS indicator generally has no features of mass and completeness, and instead embodies small sample, incomplete, short timing characteristics etc. At the same time weight is vulnerable to anthropogenic factors and difficult to accurately define. So the gray system theory provides the feasibility of eliminating weight evaluation. With the gray system theory, application of grey prediction and grey relational analysis, preliminary studies service-oriented selected QoS evaluation method.

articleTitle: A novel signal separation algorithm for a wide band direction-finding system in the HF band
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2012 2nd International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: This article describes a novel signal separation algorithm for the purpose of separating the signals overlapped both in time and frequency domain in HF Band by using direction-finding (DF) data. According to the HF wide band DF data, the time-frequency-power spectrum and its corresponding azimuth information are first transformed into azimuth-frequency-energy spectrum of DF data along the time axis; then the open and close operations of morphological image processing are applied to the azimuth-frequency-energy spectrum and isolated noise points are eliminated; finally, the region growing method of the image processing is used Through raw HF wide band DF data validation, this method is proved to be capable of realizing the separation of overlapped signals.

articleTitle: Cloud computing resource searching based on improved ACO
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2012 2nd International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology
abstract: Aiming at the problem of the cloud computing hard to find the resource. Using the improved ant colony optimization (ACO) algorithm, the resource of cloud is found in optimized cost. Though theoretical deviation, The improved ACO algorithm can get the optimization result in limited time which is shorter than the standard ACO algorithm under situation of cloud computing. The correctness of theoretical derivation is verified by the experience.
